limits.usage:
Set play limits:
/limits deposit <amount> — daily deposit cap
/limits loss <amount> — daily loss cap
/limits cooloff <24h|7d|30d> — take a break
/limits selfexclude confirm — exclude yourself for at least 6 months (cannot be undone)
